newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA AGRO-FOOD PRICES FELL 4.2 PCT IN OCTOBER.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA AGRO-FOOD PRICES FELL 4.2 PCT IN OCTOBER.

text.p: The average prices of main agro-food products sold at marketplaces in Romania went down by 4.2 percent in October from the previous month, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed on Friday.

The CNS said animal products prices -- slaughtered meat, animal fats, dairy products -- rose by 3.4 percent in October, while prices of vegetable products -- grains and flour, potatoes and fruits -- dropped by 6.2 percent.
Live animals and poultry prices saw a 0.9 percent increase in October. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
